recentItems.title: The Secret Service in HD for the First Time | Official Boxset Trailer
recentItems.description:
Pre-order now: https://gerryanderson.com/products/the-secret-service-collectors-edition-blu-ray

BISHOP has a new recruit: your Blu-ray shelf. The Secret Service is finally in HD.
Pre-orders are officially open for The Secret Service Limited Collector's Edition: the last ever Supermarionation series, restored in high definition for the very first time.
Blending puppetry with live-action performers, eccentric British humour and a wonderfully bizarre espionage premise, The Secret Service is unlike anything else in the Anderson canon. Follow Father Stanley Unwin as he secretly works for BISHOP, using the revolutionary Minimiser to battle threats to national security, with a spot of Unwinese, of course.

With its short 13-episode run and limited exposure since broadcast, it remains one of Gerry Anderson's most underappreciated productions. This meticulous restoration comes from the same team behind Joe 90 and Captain Scarlet, and the collector's edition is packed with hours of new documentaries, archival commentaries and exclusive bonus content.

Whether you're a lifelong Anderson fan or discovering The Secret Service for the first time, this is the definitive way to experience the final chapter of the Supermarionation era.

recentItems.title: Space: 1999 Comes to Cinemas in 4K This Breakaway Day | Official Trailer
recentItems.description:
Space: 1999 comes to the big screen this Breakaway Day, in 4K, for the first time ever!

To mark Breakaway Day, Anderson Entertainment presents a spectacular cinematic event for UK fans of classic science fiction: a Space: 1999 double bill uniting the groundbreaking first episode, Breakaway, with the acclaimed second-season opener The Metamorph — playing in a cinema near you.

Groundbreaking visual effects, profound questions, a stellar cast and real action. All in the unmistakable style of Gerry and Sylvia Anderson, these two landmark episodes mark the beginning of the journey, and the beginning of a new era of science fiction.

Making their worldwide debut in stunning 4K UHD, both episodes have been meticulously restored from the best surviving film elements in collaboration with leading restoration specialists Silver Salt Restoration. Expect breathtaking picture quality and a newly remixed 5.1 surround sound experience.

This is Space: 1999 as it has never been seen or heard before, now on the big screen.

recentItems.title: New Captain Scarlet: The Voice Cast's Best Behind-the-Scenes Stories!
recentItems.description:
New Captain Scarlet voice actors Julia and Wayne look back on a friendship that began during a 1993 ADR session for Richard III — and on a shared tube ride home that sealed the deal.

They talk about what made recording New Captain Scarlet different: unlike most modern animation, where actors record alone, the whole cast worked together in the same room — cliff-climbing effort sounds, fight choreography and all, just to land a single line. Julia also confesses Captain Scarlet was her childhood "dream boat," and the pair make the case for a Scarlet/Ochre romance nobody asked for, but everybody needs.

Get the full special features on the New Captain Scarlet Collector's Edition Blu-ray, available to pre-order now: https://gerryanderson.com/products/new-captain-scarlet-collectors-edition-blu-ray?

recentItems.title: The Genesis of Captain Scarlet | From Original Puppet to CGI Action Hero
recentItems.description:
Captain Scarlet is one of Gerry Anderson's most popular shows, and is the only one to be remade by Gerry himself four decades after the original. In this video, we look at the origins of Captain Scarlet, how it was received, promoted and marketed, and ultimately how it was remade in CGI the early 2000s as New Captain Scarlet.
